## 基础交互控件

{@body const [clicks,setClicks] = DIL.useState(0)}
{@body const [name,setName] = DIL.useState("ChatGPT")}
{@body const [message,setMessage] = DIL.useState("你好")}
{@body const [framework,setFramework] = DIL.useState("React")}
{@body const [radio,setRadio] = DIL.useState("A")}
{@body const [checks,setChecks] = DIL.useState(["通知"])}
{@body const [slider,setSlider] = DIL.useState(50)}
{@body const [period,setPeriod] = DIL.useState("日")}
{@body const [date,setDate] = DIL.useState("2026-11-26")}
{@body const [toggle,setToggle] = DIL.useState("开启")}
{@body const [number,setNumber] = DIL.useState("10")}
<box border padding={3} gap={3}>
  <row wrap="wrap" align="center">
    <button onClick={() => setClicks(clicks+1)}>点击我</button>
    <button color="secondary" variant="outline" onClick={() => setClicks(0)}>重置</button>
    <button color="danger" variant="soft" onClick={() => setClicks(clicks+1)}>危险按钮示例</button>
  </row>
  <text>点击次数: {clicks}</text>
  <divider color="subtle"/>
  **单行输入**
  <input value={name} onChange={setName} placeholder="输入名称"/>
  <text>实时结果: {name}</text>
  **多行输入**
  <textarea value={message} onChange={setMessage} rows={3}/>
  <text>字符数: {message.length}</text>
  **框架选择**
  <select block value={framework} onChange={setFramework} options={[{"label":"React","value":"React"},{"label":"Vue","value":"Vue"}]}/>
  <text>已选择: {framework}</text>
  **单选组**
  <radio-group value={radio} onChange={setRadio} direction="row"><radio value="A">选项 A</radio><radio value="B">选项 B</radio></radio-group>
  <text>单选: {radio}</text>
  {#each ["通知","邮件","短信"] as item}
    <checkbox checked={checks.includes(item)} onChange={v=>setChecks(old=>v?[...old,item]:old.filter(x=>x!==item))}>{item}</checkbox>
  {/each}
  <text>已选: {checks.join("、") || "无"}</text>
  <slider min={0} max={100} step={5} value={slider} onChange={setSlider}/>
  <text>音量: {slider}</text>
  **时间范围**
  <segmented-control block value={period} onChange={setPeriod} options={[{"label":"日","value":"日"},{"label":"周","value":"周"},{"label":"月","value":"月"}]}/>
  <text>当前视图: {period}</text>
  **日期选择**
  <date-picker block value={date} onChange={setDate}/>
  <text>日期: {date}</text>
  **数字输入**
  <input inputType="number" value={number} onChange={setNumber}/>
  <text>输入值: {number}</text>
  **状态切换**
  <segmented-control block value={toggle} onChange={setToggle} options={[{"label":"开启","value":"开启"},{"label":"关闭","value":"关闭"}]}/>
  <badge color={toggle==="开启"?"success":"secondary"}>{toggle}</badge>
</box>

## 布局与媒体

<row gap={2}>{#each ["A","B","C","D"] as item}<box>{item}</box>{/each}</row>

<col gap={2}>{#each ["第一行","第二行","第三行"] as item}<box>{item}</box>{/each}</col>

<grid columns={3} gap={2}>{#each ["01","02","03","04","05","06"] as item}<grid-item><box background="surface-secondary">**{item}**</box></grid-item>{/each}</grid>

<flow columns={3} gap={2}>{#each ["标签一","标签二","标签三","标签四","标签五"] as item}<flow-item><box background="surface-secondary">{item}</box></flow-item>{/each}</flow>

上方内容 <divider color="default"/> 下方内容

<box background="surface-secondary" padding={2} height="100px"><row align="center" height="100%">左侧<spacer/>右侧</row></box>

{@body const [slide,setSlide] = DIL.useState(0)}
<carousel activeIndex={slide} onChange={setSlide} showArrows visibleItems={1} gap={2}>
  <carousel-item background="surface-secondary" aspectRatio="16 / 9" justify="center" align="center"><icon name="image" size="3xl"/>**第一张幻灯片**<caption>欢迎查看组件示例</caption></carousel-item>
  <carousel-item background="surface-secondary" aspectRatio="16 / 9" justify="center" align="center"><icon name="chart-line" size="3xl"/>**第二张幻灯片**<caption>数据可视化</caption></carousel-item>
  <carousel-item background="surface-secondary" aspectRatio="16 / 9" justify="center" align="center"><icon name="code" size="3xl"/>**第三张幻灯片**<caption>进阶交互</caption></carousel-item>
</carousel>
当前幻灯片: {slide+1}/3

<popover>
  <popover-trigger><button color="secondary" variant="outline"><icon name="info" size="sm"/>点击打开弹出层</button></popover-trigger>
  <popover-content>**弹出层示例**<caption>这里可以放说明。</caption></popover-content>
</popover>

{@body const [pressed,setPressed] = DIL.useState(false)}
<pressable border padding={3} onClick={() => setPressed(!pressed)}>
  <row align="center"><icon name="mouse-pointer-click" size="xl"/><box flex="1" gap={1}>**点击整个卡片**<caption>这是可点击的容器。</caption></box><badge color={pressed?"success":"secondary"}>{pressed?"已点击":"待点击"}</badge></row>
</pressable>

<MapWidgetV2 points={[{"id":"la","name":"Los Angeles","address":"Los Angeles, California, USA"},{"id":"sf","name":"San Francisco","address":"San Francisco, California, USA"}]}/>

  {#each ["home","user","settings","search","heart","bell","calendar","camera","cloud","chart-line","folder","mail"] as ic}
    <grid-item><box background="surface-secondary" align="center"><icon name={ic} size="2xl"/><caption>{ic}</caption></box></grid-item>
  {/each}
